exercise: Junior AI Engineer take-home, Alternative C (Questionnaire Evidence & Review Workspace), starter pack 2026-10-02
instructions: Records every AI configuration used for this exercise. No credentials. Submitted as a single commit; earlier versions are described in the notes.

development_tools_and_models.notes: Claude Code desktop app (Code tab) with model claude-opus-5-5 at default settings. Version: bundled skills folder 2.1.286; the `claude` CLI on PATH reports 2.1.282. Desktop app settings are user-level and were not changed for this exercise.

plugins_and_extensions.notes: Built-in Claude Browser pane (desktop app) was used to view the review UI at http://localhost:5050 and to find a UI defect. It is built into the app, so there is nothing to export. Claude in Chrome was available but not used.

application_models_and_parameters.notes: Anthropic Messages API via LangChain (ChatPromptTemplate | ChatAnthropic; langchain-anthropic==1.7.5, langchain-core==1.6.6) over anthropic==1.11.0. Model claude-opus-5-5, structured outputs via ChatAnthropic(output_config=json_schema) (not with_structured_output, whose forced tool call this model rejects), adaptive thinking, effort medium, max_tokens 16000, timeout 120 s, 2 retries, fallbacks="default" (beta server-side-fallback-2026-07-01). No sampling parameters are set. All 21 recordings in replays/ were made through LangChain on 2026-10-05; an earlier direct-SDK set passed the same checks.

skills.notes: generate-assignment-data comes from the starter pack and was used as the fixture-preparation checklist. The claude-api skill bundled with Claude Code was used as the SDK and model reference; it is not exportable but is reproducible with the same Claude Code version.

agent_instructions_and_subagents.notes: CLAUDE.md holds the project rules for any coding agent. One built-in general-purpose subagent (no custom definition file) did a read-only code review of qra/ against data/starter/domain.md. Its findings were reproduced as failing tests before being fixed (tests/test_review_findings.py).

hooks_and_scripts.notes: No custom hooks. The desktop app's built-in behaviour of showing written files in the Browser pane is an app default, not exercise configuration.

prompts_and_rules.notes: Application prompts are versioned files and the prompt name is stored with every model call. Changing a prompt changes the request hash, so it needs new recordings.

tool_and_mcp_settings.notes: No MCP servers were configured for this project. The preview launcher (.claude/launch.json at the starter-pack root, outside this repo) only ran `python -m qra serve` against a git-ignored preview database. It was not committed because it contains absolute local paths; the equivalent command is in README.md.

permissions_and_environment_names.notes: Project permissions allow the test and app commands and deny reading .env and git push. The session ran in Claude Code auto permission mode (a user-level setting, not copied). Its classifier blocked one command that would have listed which API-key variables exist in shell profiles; I then asked the user instead. .env is git-ignored and no key is stored in the repository.
